pages.title: Podzol
pages.text: A block identical to the vanilla Podzol Block with an additional state $(l:basics/fertile_state)FERTILE$(). It is possible to use bone meal on it. It can spread. Both functions can be changed in the configuration file.

pages.title: Podzol Slab
pages.text: It has the same capabilities as a full block. By default you cannot plant plants on its lower half, but you can change this in the config file.
